data.exact_reserve_text: During 2018 we released prior year reserves of $110.0m (2017: $176.9m). Our specialty lines division increased reserve releases as the post recession portfolio from 2012 onwards matures. Specialty lines releases also included amounts from the cyber portfolio, an area that has more variability than the rest of the specialty lines account. This counter-balanced lower releases on short tail classes where the mechanical effect of reduced margins on reserve releases, along with the effects of a large series of natural disasters, is now visible. Property has been significantly impacted by higher attritional claims, as well as some strengthening on the 2017 catastrophe estimates during the year. As a result property was the only division that had a strengthening of reserves for 2018 of $48.0m. These reserve releases and strengthening are shown by division in the table below:

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a release of prior year reserves of $110.0m in 2018 driven largely by favourable development in specialty lines as the post-recession (2012 onward) portfolios matured and releases from the cyber portfolio. These releases were offset in part by a $48.0m strengthening in Property driven by higher attritional claims and some adverse movement on 2017 catastrophe estimates. The 2018 underwriting year was impacted by a series of natural catastrophes (Hurricanes Florence and Michael, Typhoons Jebi and Trami and Californian wildfires) which together increased net insurance claims by $93.3m.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development figure of $110.0m is taken from the Managing Agent narrative (explicitly stated) but the statement does not unambiguously label the amount as gross vs net of reinsurance; treated here as gross per guidance preference. The claims development triangle in the Technical Provisions contains percentage development factors and current estimates but earlier-period cumulative amount diagonals are not provided in absolute amounts, so triangle-based PYD calculation was not possible. 'Specialty lines' mapping to standard LOBs is inferred as 'Casualty' for the purposes of lob_movements; amounts for specialty reserve releases are not quantified in the text.
